title: COMMUNICATION FROM THE CITY ENGINEER relative to the final map of Tract No. 82619-03, located at 9702-9800 South Grape Street, southerly of 97th Street.
text:
[Council File 13-0174-S4; CD 15]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Not Been Held - (10 Votes Required for Consideration)]
COMMUNICATION FROM THE CITY ENGINEER relative to the final map of Tract No. 82619-03, located at 9702-9800 South Grape Street, southerly of 97th Street.
Recommendation for Council action:
APPROVE the final map of Tract No. 82619-03, located at 9702-9800 South Grape Street, southerly of 97th Street and accompanying Subdivision Improvement Agreement and Contract with security documents.
C-147060
Owner: Housing Authority of the City of Los Angeles ; Surveyor: Kurt R. Troxell/Fuscoe Engineering
Fiscal Impact Statement:
The City Engineer reports that the subdivider has paid a fee of $9,064 for the processing of this final tract map pursuant to Section 19.02(A)(2) of the Los Angeles Municipal Code. No additional City funds are needed.
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted.
summary: Council will approve the final subdivision map for a property at 9702-9800 South Grape Street, south of 97th Street, owned by the Housing Authority of the City of Los Angeles.
